messages:
alex: heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2048 renamed config keys to ConstantCase. CI fmt check now fails. Anyone okay with a tiny formatter exception or should I fix code? :shrug:

sam: saw it, pytest fmt check failing on imports. prefer code change over exceptions. quick patch incoming.

jordan: ping @sam — if it's purely name casing, linter rule might be updated instead. what's the scale? one file or many?

sam: only three files. I can open a follow-up to run `gofumpt -w` and apply import tidy. hold merge until CI green.

lev: if you do `git apply` here's a one-liner I used:
```
sed -E 's/([a-z])_([a-z])/\1\2/g' -i pkg/config/*.go
gofmt -w .
```
Not ideal but fast.

alex: posted small patch (inline):
```
- const api_key = \"API_KEY\"
+ const APIKey = \"API_KEY\"
```
also updated json tags to `json:\"api_key\"` -> `json:\"apiKey\"` in two structs.

ci-bot: fmt-check failed: files not gofumpted: pkg/config/keys.go pkg/config/server.go

sam: pushed fix that runs `gofumpt -w` in the repo and normalizes tags. requesting review @jordan

jordan: quick glance — code change looks fine. prefer to keep json tag as `api_key` for backwards compat. can we keep tag but change var name? e.g., `APIKey string `json:\"api_key\"`` — that preserves external API.

alex: good call. reverting tag changes, keeping var rename. pushed new commit.

ci-bot: all checks passed (gofumpt, unit, integration) — 1/2 approvals.

sam: one more approval from @jordan then I'll merge in the evening (merge window 18:00 PT). :thumbsup:

jordan: approving now, thanks.

sam: merged and backfilled changelog. thanks all.
